about: Public sources for the five Paloma corpora whose decontaminated training files are not public (E09). Each is sampled at random to the training budget (35,000 x 2,048 x 2,048 = 146,800,640,000 tokens of allenai/gpt-neox-olmo-dolma-v1_5). Deviations from Paloma's own versions are listed per corpus.

c4.deviation: not decontaminated against the Paloma evaluation set (a tiny fraction of documents)

pile.deviation: The Pile without Books3 (the original release is no longer distributed); not decontaminated

falcon-refinedweb.deviation: the whole public release (Paloma held out 5 %); not decontaminated

redpajama.deviation: the 'book' subset is no longer distributed and is missing; subsets are sampled in proportion to their estimated tokens; not decontaminated
